sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机地想要掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查到了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”系列的最新作品，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: 2009, the Canadian city of Mississauga had been home to Bill and Bridget Harrison for almost four decades.
sentences.zh: 2009年，比尔·哈里森和布里奇特·哈里森夫妇已经在加拿大密西沙加市居住了近四十年。

sentences.en: Located in the leafy and peaceful Erin Mills district, the Harrison's bright and spacious two-storey, six-bedroom house was a gathering place for their family and friends.
sentences.zh: 哈里森夫妇的房子位于绿树成荫、宁静祥和的艾琳米尔斯区，这是一栋明亮宽敞的双层六居室住宅，是他们与亲朋好友聚会的地方。

sentences.en: It played host to an array of backyard get-togethers and Christmas celebrations.
sentences.zh: 这里经常举办各种后院聚会和圣诞庆祝活动。

sentences.en: But, when Bridget returned to her typically lively and warm home late on Thursday, April 16, 2009, she found it uncharacteristically dark and quiet.
sentences.zh: 然而，2009年4月16日星期四深夜，当布里奇特回到她那通常热闹温馨的家中时，却发现家里异常昏暗寂静。

sentences.en: 62-year-old Bridget had spent the latter part of the day tied up in a board meeting for work.
sentences.zh: 62岁的布里奇特当天大部分时间都在参加公司董事会会议。

sentences.en: By the time she pulled into her driveway, it had just ticked past 9pm.
sentences.zh: 当她把车开进车道时，时间刚过晚上9点。

sentences.en: She parked her car in the garage and entered her house through an adjoining door, only to discover all the lights inside were off and nothing stirred within.
sentences.zh: 她把车停在车库，通过连接门走进屋里，却发现屋里所有的灯都关着，里面毫无动静。

sentences.en: Bridget called out for her husband, Bill, but was met with silence.
sentences.zh: 布里奇特呼唤丈夫比尔，但回应她的只有沉默。

sentences.en: She began checking each room on the lower half of the house for him.
sentences.zh: 她开始检查楼下房间，寻找丈夫。

sentences.en: A soft glow emanated from the living room where Bridget found the television playing to no one.
sentences.zh: 客厅里透出微弱的光，布里奇特发现电视开着，却空无一人。

sentences.en: On the coffee table in front of it was some neglected, half-eaten take-out food.
sentences.zh: 电视机前的茶几上放着一些没吃完的外卖，看起来已经放了很久。

sentences.en: Thinking that Bill might have gone to bed, Bridget headed upstairs to their room.
sentences.zh: 布里奇特以为比尔可能已经上床睡觉了，于是上楼去了他们的卧室。

sentences.en: But he wasn't there either.
sentences.zh: 但他也不在那里。

sentences.en: As Bridget made her way back downstairs, something caught her eye.
sentences.zh: 当布里奇特走回楼下时，有什么东西引起了她的注意。

sentences.en: The door to the powder room at the left of the staircase was closed.
sentences.zh: 楼梯左侧洗手间的门关着。

sentences.en: Bridget tried the handle.
sentences.zh: 布里奇特试了试门把手。

sentences.en: It was locked from the inside.
sentences.zh: 门从里面锁上了。

sentences.en: She retrieved a pin and used it to pick the lock.
sentences.zh: 她找来一根别针，用它撬开了锁。

sentences.en: Inside, Bill's body lay slumped against the far wall, wedged between the toilet and the door.
sentences.zh: 里面，比尔的尸体瘫倒在远处的墙边，卡在马桶和门之间。

sentences.en: First responders gained access to the powder room where they immediately pronounced Bill Harrison dead.
sentences.zh: 急救人员进入洗手间，当场宣布比尔·哈里森死亡。

sentences.en: As there was no overt evidence of foul play, police at the scene believed that Bill had died from natural causes.
sentences.zh: 由于没有明显的他杀迹象，现场警察认为比尔是自然死亡。

sentences.en: A coroner was summoned to the Harrison home, as sudden death cases required their input to formally rule out the possibility of a homicide.
sentences.zh: 法医被传唤到哈里森家中，因为猝死案件需要他们的介入，以正式排除他杀的可能性。

sentences.en: When a coroner viewed Bill's body in situ, he noticed faint bruising on Bill's forehead and nose.
sentences.zh: 当法医在现场查看比尔的尸体时，注意到他的前额和鼻子上有一些淡淡的淤青。

sentences.en: There were also two linear red marks around Bill's throat that were believed to have been caused by a box gold chain he wore around his neck.
sentences.zh: 比尔喉咙周围还有两道红色的线性痕迹，据信是他脖子上戴的金链子造成的。

sentences.en: The coroner ultimately agreed that Bill Harrison's cause of death appeared to be natural and didn't require any further police involvement.
sentences.zh: 法医最终同意比尔·哈里森的死因看起来是自然死亡，不需要警方进一步介入。

sentences.en: An autopsy was performed to determine why Bill had died.
sentences.zh: 随后进行了尸检以确定比尔的死因。

sentences.en: Given the coroner's thoughts on the matter, the autopsy wasn't intended to uncover evidence for a police investigation or any subsequent prosecution.
sentences.zh: 鉴于法医对此事的看法，这次尸检并非旨在为警方调查或随后的起诉寻找证据。

sentences.en: It was performed by a regular pathologist, whose knowledge was based in seeking the cause and effect of diseases.
sentences.zh: 尸检由一名普通病理学家进行，其知识基础在于探寻疾病的因果关系。

sentences.en: The pathologist performing Bill's autopsy discovered another relatively serious bruise at the front of Bill's scalp.
sentences.zh: 进行比尔尸检的病理学家在比尔头皮前部发现了另一处相对严重的淤青。

sentences.en: As there was no trauma to the brain or skull, the pathologist noted the bruising was compatible with the victim striking his head during a sudden collapse.
sentences.zh: 由于大脑或颅骨没有受到创伤，病理学家指出，淤青与受害者在突然倒地时头部撞击的情况相符。

sentences.en: It was also discovered that Bill's sternum, a T-shaped vertical bone in the central part of the chest, was broken.
sentences.zh: 此外还发现，比尔的胸骨（胸部中央的T形垂直骨骼）骨折了。

sentences.en: Aware that Bill's death was not being viewed as suspicious, the pathologist theorised that Bill's body had struck the powder room sink mid-fall, causing the fracture and bruising.
sentences.zh: 由于知道比尔的死未被视为可疑，病理学家推测比尔的身体在倒地过程中撞到了洗手间的洗手池，从而导致了骨折和淤青。

sentences.en: In his report, the pathologist concluded that Bill had suffered from acute cardiac arrhythmia, an irregular heartbeat that can have fatal results.
sentences.zh: 病理学家在报告中得出结论，比尔患有急性心律失常，这是一种可能导致致命后果的心跳不规则。

sentences.en: Bill Harrison's death was officially ruled the result of natural causes, and his case was closed.
sentences.zh: 比尔·哈里森的死被正式裁定为自然死亡，案件随之结案。

sentences.en: Bridget Harrison had lost her husband of 40 years.
sentences.zh: 布里奇特·哈里森失去了与她相伴40年的丈夫。

sentences.en: Bridget was raised in London, Ontario, where she had found success as an actress.
sentences.zh: 布里奇特在安大略省伦敦市长大，曾是一名成功的演员。

sentences.en: It was backstage during one of her theatre shows where she met Bill, who worked in the production's costume department.
sentences.zh: 她是在一次戏剧演出的后台认识比尔的，当时比尔在剧组的服装部门工作。

sentences.en: Naturally calm, wise and level-headed, Bill complimented Bridget's more passionate and fiery personality.
sentences.zh: 比尔天性冷静、睿智且沉稳，与布里奇特充满激情和火爆的性格形成了互补。

sentences.en: The pair married in 1969 and moved to Mississauga, where Bridget began a new career in education.
sentences.zh: 两人于1969年结婚并搬到密西沙加，布里奇特在那里开启了教育事业的新篇章。

sentences.en: As a teacher, she was beloved by colleagues and students alike.
sentences.zh: 作为一名教师，她深受同事和学生的爱戴。

sentences.en: A determined visionary and engaging mentor, Bridget was promoted into greater roles.
sentences.zh: 作为一名坚定的梦想家和引人入胜的导师，布里奇特不断获得晋升。

sentences.en: She rose steadily through the ranks before earning her current position working directly with Ontario's Minister of Education.
sentences.zh: 她稳步晋升，最终获得了目前直接为安大略省教育部长工作的职位。

sentences.en: Bill found his footing in sales and management.
sentences.zh: 比尔则在销售和管理领域找到了自己的立足点。

sentences.en: The Harrison's relationship wasn't without hardships.
sentences.zh: 哈里森夫妇的关系并非没有经历过磨难。

sentences.en: Bill was black and Bridget was white.
sentences.zh: 比尔是黑人，布里奇特是白人。

sentences.en: As a result, they endured judgement from outsiders for being a, quote, mixed-race couple.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们承受了外界对他们这对所谓的“跨种族夫妇”的评头论足。

sentences.en: Bill and Bridget rose above the bigotry to become an inseparable team, known for their warmth and generosity.
sentences.zh: 比尔和布里奇特超越了偏见，成为了一对形影不离的搭档，以他们的热情和慷慨而闻名。

sentences.en: In 1973, upon learning they were unable to conceive children, the couple adopted a six-month-old black boy named Caleb.
sentences.zh: 1973年，在得知无法生育后，夫妇俩收养了一个六个月大的黑人男孩，取名迦勒。

sentences.en: Described as a little rascal, Caleb's cheekiness and curiosity kept the Harrisons on their toes, but they were nevertheless happy with the life they had fostered together.
sentences.zh: 迦勒被形容为一个“小淘气”，他的顽皮和好奇心让哈里森夫妇时刻保持警惕，但他们对共同营造的生活感到幸福。

sentences.en: After Bill's unexpected death, Bridget found herself alone in their grand family house.
sentences.zh: 比尔意外去世后，布里奇特发现自己独自住在这栋宏伟的家庭住宅里。

sentences.en: The now 40-year-old Caleb Harrison moved in to offer his grieving mother some companionship.
sentences.zh: 当时40岁的迦勒·哈里森搬了进来，为悲痛中的母亲提供陪伴。

sentences.en: The move proved beneficial to Caleb, who had recently been released from prison and needed a place to live.
sentences.zh: 这次搬迁对迦勒来说是有益的，他刚从监狱释放，需要一个住处。

sentences.en: He also had two children under the age of 10.
sentences.zh: 他还有两个10岁以下的孩子。

sentences.en: Bridget loved her grandchildren and found solace in their joyful presence.
sentences.zh: 布里奇特深爱着她的孙辈，并从他们欢乐的陪伴中找到了慰藉。

sentences.en: However, it wasn't long before tension arose between Bridget and Caleb.
sentences.zh: 然而，没过多久，布里奇特和迦勒之间就产生了紧张关系。

sentences.en: Without Bill, who was described as the family's rock and peacekeeper, the two argued often.
sentences.zh: 没有了被视为家庭支柱和调解人的比尔，两人经常发生争吵。

sentences.en: On the afternoon of Wednesday, April 21, 2010, Caleb's eight-year-old son arrived home from school.
sentences.zh: 2010年4月21日星期三下午，迦勒8岁的儿子放学回家。

sentences.en: The Harrisons' front door was unlocked.
sentences.zh: 哈里森家的前门没锁。

sentences.en: A few steps in, on the tiled floor at the base of the carpeted staircase, lay Bridget Harrison's motionless body.
sentences.zh: 往里走几步，在铺着地毯的楼梯底部的瓷砖地板上，躺着布里奇特·哈里森一动不动的身体。

sentences.en: She was face up, with her hands by her sides and her head resting on the bottom step.
sentences.zh: 她仰面朝上，双手放在身体两侧，头靠在最底层的台阶上。

sentences.en: Emergency services rushed to the scene, only to pronounce Bridget deceased.
sentences.zh: 急救人员赶到现场，宣布布里奇特已经死亡。

sentences.en: She had passed away only one metre from the powder room where her husband had died a little over a year earlier.
sentences.zh: 她去世的地方距离她丈夫一年多前去世的洗手间仅一米之遥。

sentences.en: Bridget was fully dressed with her shoes on.
sentences.zh: 布里奇特衣着整齐，穿着鞋子。

sentences.en: Her wallet and eyeglasses were lying alongside her.
sentences.zh: 她的钱包和眼镜就放在她身边。

sentences.en: This led police to believe she had been getting ready to leave the house when she took a nasty and fatal spill down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 这让警方认为她当时正准备出门，却在楼梯上摔了一跤，导致了致命的后果。

sentences.en: With no signs of forced entry into the Harrison home, a responding officer concluded in his report.
sentences.zh: 由于哈里森家没有强行闯入的迹象，一名出警警官在报告中得出结论。

sentences.en: All in all, the scene has nothing to indicate foul play or a struggle.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，现场没有任何迹象表明存在谋杀或挣扎。

sentences.en: The coroner wasn't so sure.
sentences.zh: 但法医并不这么认为。

sentences.en: Blood vessels in Bridget's eyes and cheeks had burSt.
sentences.zh: 布里奇特的眼睛和脸颊里的血管破裂了。

sentences.en: There was also bruising and abrasions on her chin and neck, which was hyperextended as though she had been strangled.
sentences.zh: 她的下巴和脖子上也有淤青和擦伤，脖子过度伸展，看起来像是被勒过。

sentences.en: Bones in the back of her neck were also broken.
sentences.zh: 她后颈的骨头也断了。

sentences.en: This led to the coroner classifying Bridget's death as undetermined.
sentences.zh: 这导致法医将布里奇特的死因定为“未定”。

sentences.en: He ordered that her body undergo a full forensic autopsy.
sentences.zh: 他下令对她的尸体进行全面的法医尸检。

sentences.en: At this point, detectives for the Homicide Bureau should have taken control of Bridget's case.
sentences.zh: 此时，凶杀组的侦探本应接手布里奇特的案件。

sentences.en: They were aware of it, but ultimately left the investigation to the local division's Criminal Investigations Bureau.
sentences.zh: 他们知道这件事，但最终还是把调查留给了当地分局的刑事调查局。

sentences.en: They began looking into people who stood to gain from Bridget's death.
sentences.zh: 他们开始调查那些能从布里奇特之死中获益的人。

sentences.en: Raising Caleb was no easy feat for Bill and Bridget Harrison.
sentences.zh: 对于比尔和布里奇特·哈里森来说，抚养迦勒并非易事。

sentences.en: His school years were difficult.
sentences.zh: 他的学生时代很艰难。

sentences.en: Caleb would lash out at his teachers and test their patience, much to the dismay of Bridget, who herself was a teacher.
sentences.zh: 迦勒经常对老师发火，考验他们的耐心，这让身为教师的布里奇特感到非常失望。

sentences.en: He was also teased by his peers.
sentences.zh: 他也经常受到同龄人的嘲笑。

sentences.en: Bridget had high expectations for Caleb and wanted him to do well.
sentences.zh: 布里奇特对迦勒寄予厚望，希望他能有出息。

sentences.en: While the mother and son loved each other, they often clashed over Caleb's behaviour.
sentences.zh: 虽然母子俩彼此相爱，但他们经常因为迦勒的行为而发生冲突。

sentences.en: Bill did his best to ease tensions, with his trademark pacificity often acting as a bridge between the quarrelling Bridget and Caleb.
sentences.zh: 比尔尽其所能缓解紧张局势，他标志性的平和往往成为争吵中的布里奇特和迦勒之间的桥梁。

sentences.en: The family had a lot of great times together, including interstate trips, but Bridget and Caleb never outgrew their habit of disputing one another.
sentences.zh: 这个家庭曾有过许多美好的时光，包括州际旅行，但布里奇特和迦勒从未改掉互相争吵的习惯。

sentences.en: Caleb grew up into a witty young man that others found fun to be around.
sentences.zh: 迦勒长大后成了一个风趣的年轻人，别人都觉得和他在一起很有趣。

sentences.en: Driven like his parents, Caleb entered the workforce immediately after graduating high school.
sentences.zh: 像他的父母一样有干劲，迦勒高中毕业后立即进入了职场。

sentences.en: He began working for a shipping and receiving business.
sentences.zh: 他开始在一家物流收发公司工作。

sentences.en: As a methodical person who thrived in a routine-based environment, the role suited Caleb.
sentences.zh: 作为一个做事有条理、在常规环境中表现出色的人，这个职位很适合迦勒。

sentences.en: He quickly earned the reputation as a dedicated and hard-working employee.
sentences.zh: 他很快赢得了敬业和勤奋员工的声誉。

sentences.en: In the year 2000, 27-year-old Caleb crossed paths with 19-year-old Melissa Merritt.
sentences.zh: 2000年，27岁的迦勒遇到了19岁的梅丽莎·梅里特。

sentences.en: Melissa worked behind the counter of a doll store in the sprawling industrial complex where Caleb was employed.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎在迦勒工作的庞大工业园区里的一家玩偶店柜台工作。

sentences.en: Melissa found herself drawn to Caleb's outgoing personality and sense of humour.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎被迦勒外向的个性和幽默感所吸引。

sentences.en: She ended an engagement to pursue a relationship with Caleb.
sentences.zh: 她结束了一段婚约，转而追求与迦勒的关系。

sentences.en: In circumstances that mirrored those of his parents, Caleb was one half of a mixed-race couple with Melissa, who was white.
sentences.zh: 在与他父母相似的情况下，迦勒与白人女性梅丽莎组成了一对跨种族伴侣。

sentences.en: The pair married within a year.
sentences.zh: 两人在一年内结婚了。

sentences.en: Melissa aspired to be a mother and Caleb was eager to start a family.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎渴望成为母亲，迦勒也急于组建家庭。

sentences.en: Over the next three and a half years, the couple had a son and a daughter together.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的三年半里，这对夫妇生下了一儿一女。

sentences.en: They settled in a house that was less than an hour's drive from Bill and Bridget.
sentences.zh: 他们定居在一栋距离比尔和布里奇特家不到一小时车程的房子里。

sentences.en: They adored their grandchildren.
sentences.zh: 他们非常疼爱孙辈。

sentences.en: They helped the pair with their schoolwork and ferried them to their appointments and sports games.
sentences.zh: 他们帮助孩子完成学业，并接送他们参加各种预约和体育比赛。

sentences.en: Bridget was such a devoted grandmother that she changed her email address to Nana Harrison.
sentences.zh: 布里奇特是一位非常尽职的祖母，她甚至把电子邮箱地址改成了“娜娜·哈里森”。

sentences.en: Yet, by then, Caleb and Melissa's relationship was strained.
sentences.zh: 然而，那时迦勒和梅丽莎的关系已经很紧张了。

sentences.en: Caleb drank heavily and the couple often argued about finances.
sentences.zh: 迦勒酗酒严重，两人经常为经济问题争吵。

sentences.en: In June 2005, Melissa called the police on Caleb.
sentences.zh: 2005年6月，梅丽莎因迦勒的问题报了警。

sentences.en: In an affidavit, she revealed,
sentences.zh: 在一份宣誓书中，她透露：

sentences.en: Caleb put me in a headlock and hit me repeatedly in the head.
sentences.zh: “迦勒锁住我的头，反复击打我的头部。”

sentences.en: Caleb denied the allegations.
sentences.zh: 迦勒否认了这些指控。

sentences.en: He claimed that Melissa attacked him first by scratching and hitting him and his actions were done in self-defence.
sentences.zh: 他声称是梅丽莎先抓挠并击打他，他的行为属于自卫。

sentences.en: Caleb was arrested and charged with domestic assault.
sentences.zh: 迦勒被捕并被控家庭暴力。

sentences.en: He spent three nights in jail before receiving bail and a suspended sentence.
sentences.zh: 他在监狱里待了三晚，随后获得保释并被判缓刑。

sentences.en: This incident officially signalled the end of his marriage.
sentences.zh: 这次事件正式标志着他婚姻的终结。

sentences.en: Caleb moved back home with his parents.
sentences.zh: 迦勒搬回了父母家。

sentences.en: Melissa forbade him from seeing their kids, labelling him an incompetent father.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎禁止他见孩子，称他是一个不称职的父亲。

sentences.en: One month later, Caleb went to a keg party.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，迦勒去参加了一个啤酒派对。

sentences.en: As a condition of his suspended sentence, he wasn't allowed to drink alcohol, so he opted to be a designated driver.
sentences.zh: 作为缓刑条件，他不允许饮酒，所以他选择担任指定司机。

sentences.en: He drove his mother's car to the party, picking up several friends along the way.
sentences.zh: 他开着母亲的车去参加派对，沿途接了几位朋友。

sentences.en: However, during the party, Caleb started drinking.
sentences.zh: 然而，在派对期间，迦勒开始喝酒。

sentences.en: Those closest to Caleb knew that he was devastated to have been separated from his children and that he used alcohol as a coping mechanism.
sentences.zh: 迦勒身边最亲近的人都知道，他因与孩子分离而悲痛欲绝，并以酒精作为应对机制。

sentences.en: When the party started winding down at around 3am, Caleb decided to drive home.
sentences.zh: 凌晨3点左右，派对接近尾声时，迦勒决定开车回家。

sentences.en: His friends tried to talk him out of it, but he wouldn't listen.
sentences.zh: 朋友们试图劝阻他，但他根本听不进去。

sentences.en: They refused to get in the car with Caleb behind the wheel, so he drove off without them.
sentences.zh: 他们拒绝坐迦勒开的车，于是他独自开车离开了。

sentences.en: Caleb was around 10km from his parents' home when his car veered onto the wrong side of the road.
sentences.zh: 迦勒在距离父母家约10公里处时，车子驶入了逆行车道。

sentences.en: He collided head-on with a taxi carrying four passengers.
sentences.zh: 他与一辆载有四名乘客的出租车迎面相撞。

sentences.en: Both vehicles were driving 100km per hour, resulting in a catastrophic crash.
sentences.zh: 两辆车当时的时速均为100公里，导致了一场灾难性的车祸。

sentences.en: Those involved sustained serious injuries, including many broken bones, and one passenger had been scalped.
sentences.zh: 相关人员受了重伤，包括多处骨折，其中一名乘客被剥了头皮。

sentences.en: Upon arriving at hospital, 44-year-old taxi driver Michael Raymond's condition deteriorated quickly.
sentences.zh: 到达医院后，44岁的出租车司机迈克尔·雷蒙德的病情迅速恶化。

sentences.en: He died from his injuries the following day.
sentences.zh: 他于次日因伤势过重去世。

sentences.en: Miraculously, everyone else survived.
sentences.zh: 奇迹般的是，其他所有人都活了下来。

sentences.en: Caleb Harrison was two and a half times over the legal alcohol limit at the time of the collision.
sentences.zh: 车祸发生时，迦勒·哈里森体内的酒精含量是法定限值的两倍半。

sentences.en: He was charged with three counts of impaired driving causing bodily harm, and one count of impaired driving causing death.
sentences.zh: 他被控三项酒驾致人身体伤害罪，以及一项酒驾致人死亡罪。

sentences.en: He was released on bail to await trial under the condition that he remained living with his parents.
sentences.zh: 他获准保释等待审判，条件是必须继续与父母同住。

sentences.en: A judge allowed Caleb's two children to stay with him at the Harrison residence for two days a week, as well as every second weekend.
sentences.zh: 法官允许迦勒的两个孩子每周在哈里森家住两天，以及每隔一个周末住一次。

sentences.en: This did nothing to quell the animosity between Caleb and Melissa.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有平息迦勒和梅丽莎之间的敌意。

sentences.en: Shortly after his release from hospital, Melissa reported that Caleb had broken into her home and physically assaulted her in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 出院后不久，梅丽莎举报迦勒闯入她的家中，并在后院对他进行了身体攻击。

sentences.en: She also accused him of assaulting their two children whenever they stayed with him at the Harrison home.
sentences.zh: 她还指控他在两个孩子住在哈里森家时对他们进行殴打。

sentences.en: Ahead of Caleb's upcoming trial, someone began an online petition on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 在迦勒即将受审之前，有人在Facebook上发起了一份在线请愿书。

sentences.en: Although they didn't know the deceased taxi driver, they were furious that Caleb had killed someone as a result of his reckless behaviour.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们并不认识那位已故的出租车司机，但他们对迦勒因鲁莽行为害死人感到愤怒。

sentences.en: The petition called for signatures in support of Caleb receiving a minimum of five years in prison.
sentences.zh: 请愿书呼吁签名支持迦勒至少被判入狱五年。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 原文如下：

sentences.en: If we can get 100,000 people to join this group, we can present this to the courts to be sure this drunk driver gets a decent sentence.
sentences.zh: “如果我们能让10万人加入这个小组，我们就能把它提交给法院，确保这个酒驾司机得到应有的惩罚。”

sentences.en: Please help us to ensure a bit of justice is served.
sentences.zh: “请帮助我们确保正义得到伸张。”

sentences.en: A good man lost his life over this.
sentences.zh: “一个好人因此失去了生命。”

sentences.en: In the week leading up to the trial, the petition had just over 300 signatures.
sentences.zh: 在审判前的一周，这份请愿书只有300多个签名。

sentences.en: Caleb Harrison faced court in January 2009.
sentences.zh: 迦勒·哈里森于2009年1月出庭受审。

sentences.en: His lawyer argued that Caleb should receive no jail time, stating that Caleb was rehabilitated and incredibly remorseful.
sentences.zh: 他的律师辩称迦勒不应被判入狱，称他已经改过自新，并表现出极大的悔意。

sentences.en: Caleb's family and colleagues attested to his good character, describing him as a hard worker and loving father.
sentences.zh: 迦勒的家人和同事证明他品行端正，称他是一个勤奋的员工和慈爱的父亲。

sentences.en: While acknowledging that Caleb seemed to be a decent man with many positive attributes,
sentences.zh: 虽然承认迦勒看起来是个体面的人，有很多优点，

sentences.en: the judge said that the gravity of the offence and the degree of responsibility required incarceration.
sentences.zh: 但法官表示，犯罪的严重性和应承担的责任程度要求必须判处监禁。

sentences.en: He sentenced Caleb to 18 months jail with a further two years probation.
sentences.zh: 他判处迦勒18个月监禁，外加两年缓刑。

sentences.en: His licence was also suspended for two years.
sentences.zh: 他的驾照也被吊销了两年。

sentences.en: Caleb had only been in prison for a month when his father died unexpectedly.
sentences.zh: 迦勒入狱仅一个月，他的父亲就意外去世了。

sentences.en: Caleb was given day release to mourn with his family.
sentences.zh: 迦勒获准保外就医一天，以便与家人一起哀悼。

sentences.en: In June 2009, he was released from prison early for good behaviour, having served just three months.
sentences.zh: 2009年6月，因表现良好，他在服刑仅三个月后便提前获释。

sentences.en: Caleb moved back into his parents' Erin Mills home to be with his grieving mother.
sentences.zh: 迦勒搬回了位于艾琳米尔斯的父母家中，陪伴悲痛欲绝的母亲。

sentences.en: Less than a year later, Bridget was found dead at the bottom of the staircase.
sentences.zh: 不到一年后，布丽奇特被发现死在楼梯底部。

sentences.en: Caleb was questioned in relation to his mother's death.
sentences.zh: 迦勒因母亲的死亡而受到质询。

sentences.en: While he denied any involvement, the interviewing officer took note of how calm and unaffected Caleb seemed by the sudden loss.
sentences.zh: 尽管他否认与此事有任何牵连，但负责采访的警官注意到，面对突如其来的变故，迦勒显得异常冷静，毫无波澜。

sentences.en: Others were interviewed in relation to the case, including Caleb's ex-wife, Melissa Merritt.
sentences.zh: 警方还就此案采访了其他人，包括迦勒的前妻梅丽莎·梅里特。

sentences.en: Speaking about the domestic violence she experienced from Caleb, Melissa said,
sentences.zh: 在谈到她从迦勒那里遭受的家庭暴力时，梅丽莎说，

sentences.en: She also revealed that Caleb didn't have a good relationship with his mother, before clarifying,
sentences.zh: 她还透露迦勒与他母亲的关系并不好，随后又澄清道，

sentences.en: I'm not in any way pointing fingers, and I'm not saying that's enough to do something to her.
sentences.zh: 我绝不是在指责谁，我也没有说这足以成为对她下手的理由。

sentences.en: Unlike her husband's autopsy, Bridget Harrison's was fronted by a forensic pathologiSt.
sentences.zh: 与她丈夫的尸检不同，布丽奇特·哈里森的尸检是由法医病理学家负责的。

sentences.en: Their approach to examining a corpse is medico-legal, as their findings could form part of a police investigation or criminal prosecutions.
sentences.zh: 他们检查尸体的方法具有法医学性质，因为他们的发现可能构成警方调查或刑事起诉的一部分。

sentences.en: As such, they specialise in examining injuries.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们专门负责检查伤情。

sentences.en: The forensic pathologist examining Bridget Harrison's body noted that the fractured bones in the rear of her neck were not typically seen in neck compression cases.
sentences.zh: 检查布丽奇特·哈里森尸体的法医病理学家指出，她颈部后方骨折的情况在颈部受压案件中并不常见。

sentences.en: Marks across her chin and neck could have been the result of her body hitting the stair rail during a fall.
sentences.zh: 她下巴和颈部的痕迹可能是她在跌倒时身体撞击楼梯扶手造成的。

sentences.en: There were also no signs of hemorrhaging in Bridget's neck muscles, indicative of strangulation.
sentences.zh: 布丽奇特的颈部肌肉也没有出血迹象，这通常是勒死的征兆。

sentences.en: With findings supporting both the fall and strangulation theories, the forensic pathologist was reluctant to favour either.
sentences.zh: 由于证据既支持跌倒理论，也支持勒死理论，法医病理学家不愿偏袒任何一方。

sentences.en: Instead, Bridget's cause of death was listed as neck injuries.
sentences.zh: 最终，布丽奇特的死因被列为颈部损伤。

sentences.en: A meeting between different investigative authorities on the incident led to the regional police concluding,
sentences.zh: 不同调查机构就此事件召开会议，导致地区警方得出结论：

sentences.en: At this time, it is unknown how Bridget Harrison suffered these injuries.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚布丽奇特·哈里森是如何遭受这些伤害的。

sentences.en: After two weeks, the investigation into Bridget Harrison's death ended.
sentences.zh: 两周后，针对布丽奇特·哈里森死亡的调查结束了。

sentences.en: The case's lead detective concluded,
sentences.zh: 该案的首席侦探总结道：

sentences.en: There has been no evidence to suggest Bridget Harrison was the victim of foul play or any criminal act.
sentences.zh: 没有证据表明布丽奇特·哈里森是谋杀或其他犯罪行为的受害者。

sentences.en: Caleb Harrison settled in to continue living at his parents' home.
sentences.zh: 迦勒·哈里森安顿下来，继续住在父母家中。

sentences.en: He secured a job at an electronics company, started a new relationship, retained shared custody of his children, and stayed out of trouble.
sentences.zh: 他在一家电子公司找到了一份工作，开始了新的恋情，保留了孩子的共同监护权，并且没有再惹麻烦。

sentences.en: He told a friend that while he was depressed about his parents' deaths, his two children inspired him to keep going.
sentences.zh: 他告诉一位朋友，虽然父母的去世让他感到沮丧，但他的两个孩子激励着他继续前行。

sentences.en: By August 2013, three years had passed since Bridget Harrison passed away.
sentences.zh: 到2013年8月，布丽奇特·哈里森去世已经三年了。

sentences.en: On the 22nd of that month, Caleb finished work and drove to the local softball field to coach his daughter's softball team.
sentences.zh: 当月22日，迦勒下班后开车前往当地的垒球场，指导他女儿的垒球队。

sentences.en: Melissa had custody of the kids that day, so she was there along with her new husband.
sentences.zh: 那天梅丽莎拥有孩子的监护权，所以她和她的新丈夫也在场。

sentences.en: Afterwards, Caleb drove home alone.
sentences.zh: 之后，迦勒独自开车回家。

sentences.en: He watched television and had a drink before phoning his girlfriend at around 11pm.
sentences.zh: 他在晚上11点左右给女朋友打电话前，看了电视并喝了一杯酒。

sentences.en: He then went to bed.
sentences.zh: 然后他就上床睡觉了。

sentences.en: Caleb was a light sleeper, so he slept with an eye mask on and also left a fan running all night to drown out any noise.
sentences.zh: 迦勒睡眠很浅，所以他戴着眼罩睡觉，还整晚开着风扇来掩盖噪音。

sentences.en: The next day, Caleb didn't show up for work.
sentences.zh: 第二天，迦勒没有去上班。

sentences.en: Colleagues tried to call his mobile phone, but there was no answer.
sentences.zh: 同事们试图拨打他的手机，但无人接听。

sentences.en: At around midday, a co-worker drove to the Harrison family home.
sentences.zh: 中午左右，一位同事开车去了哈里森家。

sentences.en: He was greeted by Caleb's housekeeper.
sentences.zh: 迎接他的是迦勒的管家。

sentences.en: She hadn't seen Caleb in the two hours she'd been at the house.
sentences.zh: 她在屋里的两个小时里一直没见到迦勒。

sentences.en: Yet, she hadn't gotten around to cleaning upstairs where the main bedroom was located.
sentences.zh: 然而，她还没来得及打扫主卧室所在的楼上。

sentences.en: Caleb's colleague headed inside and went up to Caleb's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 迦勒的同事走进屋里，上了迦勒的卧室。

sentences.en: The housekeeper followed close behind, whispering repeatedly,
sentences.zh: 管家紧随其后，反复低声说道：

sentences.en: I'm scared.
sentences.zh: 我很害怕。

sentences.en: I'm scared.
sentences.zh: 我很害怕。

sentences.en: They reached the end of the hallway and knocked on Caleb's door.
sentences.zh: 他们走到走廊尽头，敲了敲迦勒的房门。

sentences.en: There was no response.
sentences.zh: 里面没有回应。

sentences.en: The pair let themselves in.
sentences.zh: 两人自行推门而入。

sentences.en: Caleb was lying in his bed.
sentences.zh: 迦勒躺在床上。

sentences.en: His blanket was pulled up to his chin and his eye mask was on.
sentences.zh: 他的毯子拉到下巴处，戴着眼罩。

sentences.en: He didn't stir when the others called out to him to wake up.
sentences.zh: 当其他人叫他醒来时，他一动不动。

sentences.en: 40-year-old Caleb Harrison was dead.
sentences.zh: 40岁的迦勒·哈里森已经死了。

sentences.en: Upon arriving at the Harrison House, police were greeted by what appeared to be a robbery gone wrong.
sentences.zh: 警察到达哈里森家时，看到现场似乎是一起入室抢劫未遂。

sentences.en: Yet, it quickly became clear that something else was at play.
sentences.zh: 然而，很快就很清楚，事情另有隐情。

sentences.en: The crime was entirely contained in Caleb Harrison's bedroom, where nothing had been stolen.
sentences.zh: 犯罪完全局限在迦勒·哈里森的卧室里，那里什么东西都没丢。

sentences.en: There were also no signs of a break-in.
sentences.zh: 也没有任何闯入的迹象。

sentences.en: The intruder had the element of surprise, striking Caleb as he slept in bed.
sentences.zh: 入侵者利用了出其不意的优势，在迦勒熟睡时对他进行了袭击。

sentences.en: An altercation ensued, during which a shelving unit had been knocked over.
sentences.zh: 随后发生了争执，期间一个搁架单元被撞倒了。

sentences.en: Caleb's knuckles were swollen and there were foreign skin scrapings under his fingernails, showing that he had put up a fight.
sentences.zh: 迦勒的指关节肿胀，指甲下有外来的皮肤碎屑，表明他进行了反抗。

sentences.en: Yet, his killer had staged the scene by putting Caleb's body back in bed, as if he had died in his sleep.
sentences.zh: 然而，凶手伪造了现场，把迦勒的尸体放回床上，就像他是死于睡梦中一样。

sentences.en: An autopsy revealed that the hyoid bone in Caleb's neck was broken and there was damage to the cartilage of his voice box.
sentences.zh: 尸检显示，迦勒颈部的舌骨骨折，喉头软骨受损。

sentences.en: This, coupled with bruising and abrasions on the exterior of his neck, determined the cause of his death to be strangulation.
sentences.zh: 再加上他颈部外部的淤青和擦伤，确定他的死因是勒死。

sentences.en: Caleb was the third and final Harrison family member to die inside the Aaron Mills house within a four-year period.
sentences.zh: 迦勒是四年内死在艾琳米尔斯这所房子里的第三位，也是最后一位哈里森家族成员。

sentences.en: A homicide investigation was finally launched, prompting authorities to reflect on the circumstances surrounding Bill and Bridget's deaths.
sentences.zh: 凶杀案调查终于启动，促使当局反思比尔和布丽奇特死亡的情况。

sentences.en: A detective told the Mississauga News,
sentences.zh: 一位侦探告诉《密西沙加新闻》：

sentences.en: Anything, in absence of an explanation, may seem strange.
sentences.zh: 在缺乏解释的情况下，任何事情都可能显得奇怪。

sentences.en: But there's obviously some very poignant events that happened to one family.
sentences.zh: 但显然，这个家庭发生了一些非常令人痛心的事件。

sentences.en: To have three sudden deaths occur in the same household is unusual.
sentences.zh: 在同一个家庭中发生三起猝死事件是不寻常的。

sentences.en: We would be remiss if we didn't do our due diligence and look at all three deaths in totality.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不尽职调查，不全面审视这三起死亡事件，那将是我们的失职。

sentences.en: We haven't linked anything.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有将任何事情联系起来。

sentences.en: However, everything is on the table.
sentences.zh: 然而，一切皆有可能。

sentences.en: The theory that someone was targeting the Harrison family was one held by their loved ones for years.
sentences.zh: 有人针对哈里森家族的理论，多年来一直被他们的亲人所持有。

sentences.en: From the outset, they had trouble accepting that Bill had died from a heart condition.
sentences.zh: 从一开始，他们就很难接受比尔死于心脏病。

sentences.en: It just didn't make sense for a man who exercised a daily, ate a healthy diet and was physically fit.
sentences.zh: 对于一个每天锻炼、饮食健康且身体强壮的人来说，这根本说不通。

sentences.en: Even Bridget suspected that something wasn't right about her husband's death.
sentences.zh: 甚至布丽奇特也怀疑她丈夫的死有些不对劲。

sentences.en: She'd brought up her concerns to police on several occasions, asking why the powder room door was locked from the inside if Bill was home alone at the time.
sentences.zh: 她曾多次向警方提出担忧，询问如果比尔当时独自在家，为什么化妆室的门是从里面锁上的。

sentences.en: And why were all the lights off if Bill was up and using the bathroom?
sentences.zh: 如果比尔当时起床去洗手间，为什么所有的灯都关着？

sentences.en: By the time investigators acknowledged these questions, it was too late.
sentences.zh: 当调查人员意识到这些问题时，已经太晚了。

sentences.en: Bill's body couldn't be exhumed for further testing as it had been cremated a week after his death.
sentences.zh: 比尔的尸体无法进行进一步的尸检，因为他在去世一周后就被火化了。

sentences.en: Bridget's untimely and unexplained death a year later only confirmed suspicions held by her loved ones that a killer was on the loose.
sentences.zh: 一年后布丽奇特那不合时宜且无法解释的死亡，只会证实她亲人们认为有凶手逍遥法外的怀疑。

sentences.en: They pushed law enforcement to reopen Bill and Bridget's cases.
sentences.zh: 他们敦促执法部门重新开启比尔和布丽奇特的案件。

sentences.en: The family was told that their suspicions were not enough.
sentences.zh: 家人被告知他们的怀疑还不够充分。

sentences.en: The police wanted proof.
sentences.zh: 警方想要证据。

sentences.en: The Harrison's loved ones were at a loss.
sentences.zh: 哈里森的亲人们感到束手无策。

sentences.en: Wasn't it the job of the police to investigate and find said proof?
sentences.zh: 难道调查并找到这些证据不是警察的工作吗？

sentences.en: And now, Caleb Harrison had been murdered.
sentences.zh: 而现在，迦勒·哈里森被谋杀了。

sentences.en: How could you let this happen?
sentences.zh: 你们怎么能让这种事发生？

sentences.en: One grieving family member yelled, as the Harrison's house was taped off by police for the third time.
sentences.zh: 一位悲痛欲绝的家庭成员大喊道，此时哈里森的房子第三次被警察封锁。

sentences.en: They couldn't understand why authorities never listened to them.
sentences.zh: 他们无法理解为什么当局从不听取他们的意见。

sentences.en: They had even highlighted two suspects, telling police, nobody else has motive.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至指出了两个嫌疑人，告诉警察，没有其他人有动机。

sentences.en: The acrimony between Caleb and his ex-wife Melissa Merritt had continued up until his death, but there was a lot more to it than Melissa was willing to admit.
sentences.zh: 迦勒和他的前妻梅丽莎·梅里特之间的积怨一直持续到他去世，但这其中比梅丽莎愿意承认的要复杂得多。

sentences.en: Shortly after Caleb had been released from hospital following the fatal car crash,
sentences.zh: 在迦勒因致命车祸出院后不久，

sentences.en: Melissa had called police to report that Caleb had broken into her home and physically assaulted her.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎打电话给警察，举报迦勒闯入她的家并对他进行了人身攻击。

sentences.en: Police visited the Harrison residence to investigate, only to find that Caleb had broken his leg in the car accident.
sentences.zh: 警察前往哈里森住所进行调查，却发现迦勒在车祸中摔断了腿。

sentences.en: His leg was in a full cast, and even with the help of crutches, he could hardly walk.
sentences.zh: 他的腿打着厚厚的石膏，即使拄着拐杖，他也几乎无法行走。

sentences.en: There was no way he was capable of the allegations Melissa had made.
sentences.zh: 他根本不可能做出梅丽莎所指控的行为。

sentences.en: Regardless, Melissa continued to make several similar allegations around this time.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，梅丽莎在那段时间里还是继续提出了几项类似的指控。

sentences.en: When Caleb finally faced court for the original domestic violence allegation against him, he claimed that Melissa had been deliberately misleading police officers in what he called
sentences.zh: 当迦勒最终因最初的家庭暴力指控出庭时，他声称梅丽莎一直在故意误导警官，他称之为

sentences.en: continued attempts to implicate him in acts of abuse and create suspicion about him.
sentences.zh: 持续试图将他卷入虐待行为并制造对他怀疑的行为。

sentences.en: Police felt the same way.
sentences.zh: 警方也有同样的感觉。

sentences.en: In October 2005, four months after Melissa and Caleb had separated,
sentences.zh: 2005年10月，在梅丽莎和迦勒分居四个月后，

sentences.en: Melissa met a man online named Christopher Fattore.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎在网上认识了一个名叫克里斯托弗·法托雷的男人。

sentences.en: At 28 years old, Chris was two years older than Melissa.
sentences.zh: 克里斯28岁，比梅丽莎大两岁。

sentences.en: The pair were together for just over a year before they held a marriage ceremony.
sentences.zh: 两人在一起一年多后举行了婚礼。

sentences.en: Their union wasn't legally recognised as Melissa hadn't formally divorced from Caleb.
sentences.zh: 他们的结合在法律上并不被认可，因为梅丽莎还没有正式与迦勒离婚。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, Melissa and Chris settled in to married life.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，梅丽莎和克里斯还是安顿下来开始了婚后生活。

sentences.en: They had four children over the next five years.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的五年里，他们生了四个孩子。

sentences.en: Chris was a handyman who also occasionally worked as a security guard.
sentences.zh: 克里斯是一名杂工，偶尔也做保安。

sentences.en: It wasn't enough to support his large family, so the couple sought government assistance and loans from family and friends.
sentences.zh: 这不足以养活他的大家庭，所以这对夫妇寻求政府援助以及家人和朋友的贷款。

sentences.en: Even though she struggled to support them, Melissa wanted all six of her children under the one roof.
sentences.zh: 尽管难以维持生计，梅丽莎还是希望她的六个孩子都住在同一个屋檐下。

sentences.en: This included her eldest two children she had with Caleb, with whom she shared custody.
sentences.zh: 这包括她与迦勒所生的两个最大的孩子，她与迦勒共同拥有监护权。

sentences.en: Melissa made five separate claims to the Children's Aid Society, accusing Caleb, Bill and Bridget Harrison of assaulting the two children
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎向儿童援助协会提出了五项单独的指控，指责迦勒、比尔和布丽奇特·哈里森袭击了这两个孩子，

sentences.en: whenever they stayed at the Harrison residence.
sentences.zh: 每当他们住在哈里森家时。

sentences.en: To clear her name, Bridget kept a diary of all the interactions her family had with Melissa.
sentences.zh: 为了洗清自己的名声，布丽奇特写了一本日记，记录了她家人与梅丽莎之间的所有互动。

sentences.en: She noted the hateful and degrading way that Melissa spoke to Caleb in front of the children.
sentences.zh: 她记录了梅丽莎在孩子面前对迦勒说话时那种充满仇恨和贬低的方式。

sentences.en: On one occasion, Chris Fattore threatened,
sentences.zh: 有一次，克里斯·法托雷威胁说：

sentences.en: You'll burn in hell for the lies you've told.
sentences.zh: 你会因为你撒的谎而在地狱里燃烧。

sentences.en: On another, he yelled out of a car window,
sentences.zh: 另一次，他从车窗大喊：

sentences.en: You'll pay for this, you fucking bastard.
sentences.zh: 你会为此付出代价的，你这个混蛋。

sentences.en: The allegations that Caleb, Bill and Bridget Harrison were harming their children were determined to have been completely unfounded.
sentences.zh: 关于迦勒、比尔和布丽奇特·哈里森伤害他们孩子的指控被认定完全毫无根据。

sentences.en: Once again, Melissa Merritt was lying.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎·梅里特又一次撒谎了。

sentences.en: She had even been coaching her children on what to say to the authorities to support her outlandish claiMs.
sentences.zh: 她甚至一直在教导她的孩子们该对当局说什么，以支持她那些离谱的说法。

sentences.en: To stem the growing animosity between them, a judge ruled that Caleb and Melissa communicate through writing only.
sentences.zh: 为了遏制他们之间日益增长的敌意，法官裁定迦勒和梅丽莎只能通过书面形式进行交流。

sentences.en: It was Chris Fattore who began the online petition calling for Caleb to receive the minimum sentence for his drink-driving charges.
sentences.zh: 正是克里斯·法托雷发起了在线请愿，呼吁迦勒因酒驾指控获得最低刑期。

sentences.en: He wrote,
sentences.zh: 他写道：

sentences.en: This is Caleb Harrison, the dick that killed someone drinking and driving.
sentences.zh: 这就是凯莱布·哈里森，那个酒驾杀人的混蛋。

sentences.en: He is unfortunately also my wife's ex-husband.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，他也是我妻子的前夫。

sentences.en: Chris had posted a photo of Caleb on which he'd photoshopped devil horns and a speech bubble that read,
sentences.zh: 克里斯曾发布过一张凯莱布的照片，他在照片上用PS加上了恶魔角，并配了一个对话气泡，写着：

sentences.en: Give me beer and the keys to mummy's Mercedes.
sentences.zh: 给我啤酒，还有妈咪那辆奔驰车的钥匙。

sentences.en: Chris and Melissa attended Caleb's trial, making faces at the Harrison family in court and driving past them afterwards with their tongues poking out.
sentences.zh: 克里斯和梅丽莎参加了凯莱布的庭审，在法庭上对哈里森一家做鬼脸，事后开车经过他们时还伸出舌头嘲讽。

sentences.en: When Caleb was sentenced to 18 months in prison,
sentences.zh: 当凯莱布被判处18个月监禁时，

sentences.en: Melissa was certain she would finally receive full custody of their children.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎确信她终于能获得孩子的完全监护权了。

sentences.en: But the judge gave her joint custody with Bill and Bridget Harrison, ruling that it was in the best interest for the children to maintain the lifestyle they are used to.
sentences.zh: 但法官判决她与比尔和布丽奇特·哈里森共同监护，裁定维持孩子们习惯的生活方式最符合他们的利益。

sentences.en: Melissa was angry, stating in a subsequent email,
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎很生气，在随后的一封电子邮件中写道：

sentences.en: If Caleb is not caring for the children, then no one other than myself should be.
sentences.zh: 如果凯莱布不能照顾孩子，那么除了我之外，谁都不应该照顾他们。

sentences.en: The day after Bill Harrison was found dead,
sentences.zh: 在比尔·哈里森被发现死亡的第二天，

sentences.en: Bridget went to her grandchildren's school to check that they were doing okay.
sentences.zh: 布丽奇特去了孙子们的学校，想看看他们是否安好。

sentences.en: The kids weren't there.
sentences.zh: 孩子们不在学校。

sentences.en: As part of the shared custody order,
sentences.zh: 作为共同监护令的一部分，

sentences.en: Melissa wasn't allowed to withdraw her children from school without a doctor's note.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎在没有医生证明的情况下，不得擅自将孩子从学校接走。

sentences.en: No such note had been given to the school administration.
sentences.zh: 校方并没有收到任何此类证明。

sentences.en: Chris Fattore had inexplicably signed the children out at 1pm the previous day.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·法托雷在前一天下午1点莫名其妙地把孩子们接走了。

sentences.en: A teacher revealed that Melissa and Caleb's son had excitedly informed his classmates that he was going on a trip with his family.
sentences.zh: 一位老师透露，梅丽莎和凯莱布的儿子曾兴奋地告诉同学，他要和家人去旅行。

sentences.en: He didn't know where, as his mother was keeping at a surprise.
sentences.zh: 他不知道去哪儿，因为他妈妈想给他一个惊喜。

sentences.en: All he knew was that it would take over a day of driving to get there.
sentences.zh: 他只知道开车去那里需要一天多的时间。

sentences.en: Upon learning this, Bridget drove to Melissa and Chris' apartment.
sentences.zh: 得知此事后，布丽奇特开车去了梅丽莎和克里斯的公寓。

sentences.en: No one came to the door, which was locked.
sentences.zh: 没人来开门，门锁着。

sentences.en: The blinds were also drawn.
sentences.zh: 百叶窗也拉上了。

sentences.en: Bridget reported her grandchildren's disappearance to the police.
sentences.zh: 布丽奇特向警方报告了孙子们失踪的消息。

sentences.en: They made queries with Chris Fattore's employer, who confirmed that Chris had called in sick on the day that Bill Harrison died.
sentences.zh: 警方询问了克里斯·法托雷的雇主，对方证实克里斯在比尔·哈里森去世的那天请了病假。

sentences.en: He hadn't shown up since.
sentences.zh: 从那以后他就没再出现过。

sentences.en: Police gained access to Melissa and Chris' apartment, finding it dark and mostly empty.
sentences.zh: 警方进入了梅丽莎和克里斯的公寓，发现里面漆黑一片，几乎空无一物。

sentences.en: Days later, Bridget Harrison received an email from Melissa Merritt.
sentences.zh: 几天后，布丽奇特·哈里森收到了梅丽莎·梅里特发来的一封电子邮件。

sentences.en: In it, Melissa stated that she had fled with her family because she was receiving threatening letters from an unknown party.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎在信中称，她带着家人逃跑是因为收到了不明人士的威胁信。

sentences.en: A letter authored by Melissa and making the same claims was sent to Caleb in prison.
sentences.zh: 一封由梅丽莎撰写、内容相同的信被寄给了监狱里的凯莱布。

sentences.en: It was postmarked April 17, the day after Bill died.
sentences.zh: 邮戳日期是4月17日，也就是比尔去世的第二天。

sentences.en: When Bill Harrison's funeral was held, his grandchildren were still missing.
sentences.zh: 比尔·哈里森举行葬礼时，他的孙子们仍然下落不明。

sentences.en: The next day, Bridget was granted sole custody of the children, despite no one knowing where they were.
sentences.zh: 第二天，尽管没人知道孩子们的下落，布丽奇特还是获得了他们的唯一监护权。

sentences.en: Missing persons ads were published in newspapers across the country as Bridget sought the help of a private investigator.
sentences.zh: 全国各地的报纸都刊登了寻人启事，布丽奇特也寻求私家侦探的帮助。

sentences.en: Two months into the disappearance, Caleb was paroled.
sentences.zh: 失踪两个月后，凯莱布获得了假释。

sentences.en: Efforts to track Melissa Merritt and Chris Fattore had come up dry.
sentences.zh: 寻找梅丽莎·梅里特和克里斯·法托雷的努力都落空了。

sentences.en: By November 2009, Melissa and Chris had been missing for seven months.
sentences.zh: 到2009年11月，梅丽莎和克里斯已经失踪了七个月。

sentences.en: Approval to seize and review Melissa's banking records was granted, providing a much-needed breakthrough.
sentences.zh: 警方获准查封并审查梅丽莎的银行记录，这提供了一个急需的突破口。

sentences.en: They revealed a transaction in the Canadian province of Nova Scotia,
sentences.zh: 记录显示他们在加拿大新斯科舍省有一笔交易，

sentences.en: 1,300 kilometres east from Mississauga.
sentences.zh: 距离密西沙加市以东1300公里。

sentences.en: An arrest warrant was issued and the family were finally uncovered.
sentences.zh: 警方签发了逮捕令，这一家人终于被找到了。

sentences.en: In an effort to go undetected, Melissa had dyed her children's hair and the group were going by different names.
sentences.zh: 为了不被发现，梅丽莎把孩子们的头发染了色，他们还用了假名。

sentences.en: Melissa was charged with parental child abduction and she lost access to the two children she shared with Caleb Harrison.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎被控绑架亲生子女，并失去了对她与凯莱布·哈里森所生两个孩子的监护权。

sentences.en: They were placed in Caleb's care, who was granted shared custody with his mother, Bridget.
sentences.zh: 孩子们被安置在凯莱布的照顾下，凯莱布获准与他的母亲布丽奇特共同监护。

sentences.en: Melissa Merritt pleaded guilty and a hearing was set for April 22, 2010.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎·梅里特认罪，听证会定于2010年4月22日举行。

sentences.en: In the lead-up, Bridget Harrison prepared a victim impact statement.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，布丽奇特·哈里森准备了一份受害者影响陈述。

sentences.en: She described the seven months her grandchildren were missing as the most desperate of her life.
sentences.zh: 她形容孙子们失踪的那七个月是她一生中最绝望的时光。

sentences.en: The fact that Melissa and Chris had orchestrated their runaway on the very day Bill had died wasn't lost on Bridget.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎和克里斯在比尔去世当天就策划逃跑的事实，布丽奇特铭记在心。

sentences.en: In her statement, she wrote,
sentences.zh: 她在陈述中写道：

sentences.en: Some people believe in coincidences, some do not.
sentences.zh: 有些人相信巧合，有些人不信。

sentences.en: Bridget was never able to deliver her victim impact statement.
sentences.zh: 布丽奇特最终没能宣读她的受害者影响陈述。

sentences.en: The day before Melissa Merritt's hearing was set to begin,
sentences.zh: 在梅丽莎·梅里特的听证会预定开始的前一天，

sentences.en: Bridget was found dead.
sentences.zh: 布丽奇特被发现死亡。

sentences.en: Melissa was convicted for parental abduction and received 18 months probation.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎因绑架亲生子女被定罪，获判18个月缓刑。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, her ex-husband was growing increasingly suspicious.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，她的前夫对此越来越怀疑。

sentences.en: As detailed in the Toronto Star newspaper,
sentences.zh: 正如《多伦多星报》所详述的那样，

sentences.en: Caleb Harrison told a cousin,
sentences.zh: 凯莱布·哈里森告诉一位表亲：

sentences.en: There's no way anyone falls down the stairs and ends up in that position.
sentences.zh: 一个人不可能摔下楼梯后会呈现出那种姿势。

sentences.en: It doesn't look right.
sentences.zh: 看起来不对劲。

sentences.en: It doesn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 这说不通。

sentences.en: Caleb had even aired the same concerns to police during interviews following his mother's death.
sentences.zh: 凯莱布在母亲去世后接受警方采访时，也表达了同样的担忧。

sentences.en: He detailed his rocky history with Melissa while acknowledging the timing of Bridget's death as weird.
sentences.zh: 他详细讲述了自己与梅丽莎之间不愉快的过往，同时也承认布丽奇特去世的时机很蹊跷。

sentences.en: When asked who he thought was responsible for his mother's death,
sentences.zh: 当被问及他认为谁该为他母亲的死负责时，

sentences.en: Caleb replied,
sentences.zh: 凯莱布回答：

sentences.en: I would ask where Melissa and Chris were, personally.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言，我会问梅丽莎和克里斯当时在哪里。

sentences.en: When speaking to police about Bridget's death,
sentences.zh: 在向警方谈及布丽奇特的死时，

sentences.en: Melissa Merritt said she was at home babysitting as part of a daycare business she was trying to get up and running.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎·梅里特说她当时在家照看孩子，这是她正试图开展的一项托儿业务。

sentences.en: Chris Vettore said he'd spent the day working in his backyard and running errands.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·法托雷说他那天在后院干活并处理了一些琐事。

sentences.en: Shop surveillance cameras had captured him in town, yet there was a brief time he was unaccounted for.
sentences.zh: 商店的监控摄像头拍到了他在镇上的身影，但有一段时间他的行踪不明。

sentences.en: Chris said he had visited Melissa's grandmother to pick up a drum kit.
sentences.zh: 克里斯说他去拜访了梅丽莎的祖母，去取一套鼓。

sentences.en: Police never spoke with the woman to confirm this alibi.
sentences.zh: 警方从未找那位女士核实这个不在场证明。

sentences.en: Melissa worked to implicate Caleb in Bridget's death.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎试图将布丽奇特的死归咎于凯莱布。

sentences.en: In interviews, she referenced Caleb's history of violence against her, even though it was known to be baseless.
sentences.zh: 在采访中，她提到了凯莱布对她施暴的历史，尽管众所周知那是毫无根据的。

sentences.en: Furthermore, Caleb couldn't have killed Bridget.
sentences.zh: 此外，凯莱布不可能杀了布丽奇特。

sentences.en: An alibi placed him at work that day.
sentences.zh: 有不在场证明显示他那天在上班。

sentences.en: With that, the investigation into Bridget's death was closed.
sentences.zh: 至此，关于布丽奇特死亡的调查结案了。

sentences.en: Caleb Harrison received sole custody of his two children in the aftermath of his mother's death.
sentences.zh: 母亲去世后，凯莱布·哈里森获得了两个孩子的唯一监护权。
